findings.claim: Retail 00457FF0 used native 00494BE0/00472D30 transforms and native 00472C10 frustum classification on genuine native VCF-constructed GTSi and bus class-66 body nodes through controlled active-world entries. Under artificial view planes returned -1 on acceptance and +1 on rejection, leading to one kind-6 record or zero respectively.
findings.limitations: Artificial frustum and active-world entry; Ghidra x87 software emulation, not hardware x87 parity.

findings.claim: Original 00490590 and 0048FE10 allocate and bin a type-6 0x44-byte work record preserving world-object and active-entry pointers at +0x1C and +0x40. Under near-plane normalization the accepted test records enter bucket 1 and advance 68-byte record cursor.
findings.limitations: Synthetic registered entry and configured camera/near-far plane; byte count measured for subtype 6 only.

findings.claim: The unmodified native 00457FF0-produced kind-6 record is consumed by original 0048FAC0, dispatched through original 0048F4C0 into original 0045D530 secondary traversal, and bucket is emptied. Under the class-66 body-node test no section builder or polygon submission is reached.
findings.limitations: Body node +0x64 lacks appropriate child tree; full vehicle root and live active entry have not been executed.

findings.claim: Native 004572B0 active-world entry creation and retail camera/frustum/depth range setup are still not validated as one original-game rendering frame; root world entries and final rasterizer remain separate open work.
findings.limitations: The v4 harness constructs a controlled registry entry and camera matrix, and substitutes peripheral OS/media services.
